sources.title: GBC: The Corporation
sources.said: We are Gibraltar’s public service broadcaster. At GBC we deliver local content across TV, Radio and Online for the people of Gibraltar. GBC is an independent, publicly funded corporation which was formed in December 1963 when Radio Gibraltar (1958) and Gibraltar TV (1962) merged to create GBC.

sources.title: Gibraltar Cultural Services: Applications for Cultural and Book Grants 2027/2028 (01-Oct-2026)
sources.said: The Cultural Grants Committee invites applications for financial assistance from locally registered Cultural Organisations and/or individuals’ resident in Gibraltar or Red ID Card holders, for the financial year 1st April 2027 to 31st March 2028. Applications for financial assistance can be received for: · Participation at official international competitions and events. · Cultural development and education. · Purchase of equipment for cultural use. · Publication of books which are culturally significant to Gibraltar. All outline bids for financial assistance must include evidence of events or projects and estimated costs including quotes that will be sought by the cultural organisation. Applications from registered cultural entities must be accompanied with a copy of the last audited accounts available. … Closing date for applications is Friday 30th October 2026.

figures.finding: As item 1. GBC exists and is publicly funded. Its site publishes no commissioning terms (the corporation page and the programme index were read). The programme index has no drama category. That describes the current catalogue only, not a rule.
